instructions: Review every page with flags, and edit the site and page of any page as needed, following the site-assignment rules in docs/decisions/011-site-page-ontology.md. Pages with the same site value will belong to the same site. Do not edit description, which identifies the pages to be migrated. A home page has the page name “home”.

flagExplanations.notHomeURL: Proposed as a home page, but its URL has a path, so it may instead be a page of a site with no home-page entry (site-assignment rule 3).
flagExplanations.chainedPrefix: Its description extends a description that itself extends another, so the proposed page name contains an intermediate page name.
flagExplanations.variantSpelling: It matched its site only after normalizing case, apostrophes, quotation marks, or white space, so the site name should be unified (site-assignment rule 4).
flagExplanations.otherHost: Its host belongs to a different domain from the home page of its proposed site, so it may belong to another site (site-assignment rules 1 and 2).
flagExplanations.multipleURLs: Reports with this description have different URLs.
flagExplanations.sharedURL: Another description has a report with the same URL.
flagExplanations.nearDuplicateSite: Its proposed site name differs from another proposed site name only in case, punctuation, or a parenthesized abbreviation (site-assignment rule 4).
flagExplanations.sharedDomain: The home page of its proposed site has the same domain as the home page of another proposed site.
flagExplanations.hiddenOnly: All reports with this description are hidden, so the page is not a tested page.
